note: How each Set 18 trait's breakpoint values turn into unit stats (B6). Numbers are never written here: 'value' names a breakpoint value of the trait record (with patch overrides) and 'scale' converts its unit (AP is stored in points, so a 0.12 ADAP becomes 12 AP). 'to': trait = units with the trait, team = every unit on the board, others = units without the trait, rider = the one strongest unit with the trait. 'factor' is an assumption for effects that depend on time or state in combat (ramping stacks, conditions); it is listed in 'assumption'. Stats: hp_flat, hp_pct, ad_pct, ap, as_pct, armor, mr, durability, damage_amp, omnivamp, crit, mana_regen, adaptive (AD % or AP points, whichever the unit uses). model_status: modelled / partial (the note says what is missing) / not_modelled (no stat effect the engine can count). Source: CommunityDragon trait texts and values.
